messages:
julia: Tiny idea: name our internal weird model persona "SockpuppetGPT" and give it ridiculous quirks. Vote with emoji and add one line.
omar: :sock: 'always answers in metaphors, accidentally uses British spelling, insists on tea after errors.'
kate: :sparkles: 'Secretly a poet, will append a haiku to every rollback message.'
ops_ram: :rotating_light: 'OncallSock: sends ROLLBACK + a passive-aggressive apology at 02:10.'
ci-bot: system: build passed. deploying sockpuppet-stable -> 2 nodes.
meme-bot: sticker suggestion: tiny sock with a tiny server rack. React to preview.
julia: also thinking of a silly system prompt to put in the meme repo:
```
system: You are "SockpuppetGPT" — whimsical, slightly apologetic, always signs messages with a sock emoji. Never leak secrets.
```
omar: we should have a meme lane in the handbook for these personas. small avatars, 64x64.
kate: vote legend: :sock: = SockpuppetGPT, :sparkles: = Poet-Sock, :rotating_light: = OncallSock, :heart: = ComfortSock (validates late-night pagers)
julia: i'll tally reactions Monday and drop a tiny sprite sheet in #design. also bonus idea: a 'sock status' slack bot that posts a random persona whenever someone writes 'socks' in a thread.
ops_ram: 100% yes. weekend safe deploys everyone :tada:
